go_spectrum_br.name: Spectrum BR
go_spectrum_br.key: Per 2 tablets: 400 mg berberine HCl, 300 mg six-herb blend, 70 mg Oregon grape root, 30 mg coptis root
go_spectrum_br.src: NutriDyn sell sheet ND505 Rev. 8/24 (Spectrum BR), opened 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts per 2 tablets: berberine HCl 400 mg; Spectrum BR Blend 300 mg (ginger root, licorice root, Chinese rhubarb root, Chinese skullcap root, coptis root, phellodendron bark extracts; no per-herb amounts); Oregon grape root 4:1 extract 70 mg; coptis root extract (5% berberine) 30 mg. Directions 'Take two tablets two to three times daily'; 'Warning: Do not use if pregnant or nursing'; 'Caution: If taking medication including cyclosporine, consult your healthcare practitioner'; vegetarian. Claim wording on the sheet is the sell sheet's own: 'Promote a healthy gastrointestinal tract'. Products DB R107 (catalog ND143 10/1/26, read by the Metagenics chart) agrees. Sizes R107 90T, R107L 180T: price list ND144 10/1/26. Sheet dose (2 tablets twice daily, with meals) sits inside the label range. Remove-step use: the ND584 5R program and Asher's GI-MAP protocol (2 tablets 3 times daily). URL: nutridyn.com/spectrum-br, the slug a web search returned on 2026-11-03 (page not opened: nutridyn.com is blocked from this session).

go_nutricidin.name: Nutricidin
go_nutricidin.key: Per 2 softgels: 400 mg calcium EDTA, 250 mg ginger root, 30,000 SPU serratiopeptidase, 725 mg of 8 plant oils (100 mg each oregano, coriander, black cumin, basil, fennel; 75 mg each thyme, cinnamon, clove)
go_nutricidin.src: NutriDyn sell sheet ND949 Rev. 2/25 (Nutricidin), opened 2026-11-03. Supplement Facts per 2 softgels: calcium (as calcium EDTA) 36 mg; calcium EDTA 400 mg; ginger root extract (5% gingerols) 250 mg; oregano oil 100 mg; coriander seed oil 100 mg; black cumin seed oil (Bunium persicum) 100 mg; basil seed oil 100 mg; fennel seed oil 100 mg; red thyme oil 75 mg; cinnamon bark oil 75 mg; clove leaf oil 75 mg; serratiopeptidase 30,000 SPU (8 oils = 725 mg). Other ingredients: gelatin, sunflower seed oil, glycerin, yellow beeswax, purified water, sunflower lecithin, carob. Directions 'Take two softgels daily with food'; caution: pregnant, nursing or taking medication, consult. The sheet's 1 softgel twice daily with meals equals the label's two daily with food. Sizes R176 60S, R176L 120S: ND144 10/1/26. Asher's GI-MAP protocol: 1 softgel 3 times daily, away from probiotics. Bleeding caution on the back (ginger, clove, serratiopeptidase): Heck AM et al. Am J Health Syst Pharm 2000;57:1221-7, PMID 10902065 (ginger and clove among herbs that may raise bleeding risk with warfarin); serratiopeptidase breaks down fibrin, Hosseini SB et al. Arch Microbiol 2024;206:180, PMID 38502196, and Jadhav SB et al. Biotechnol Rep 2020;28:e00544, PMID 33134103.

go_paradex.name: Paradex
go_paradex.key: Per capsule: 250 mg black walnut hulls, 100 mg wormwood, 100 mg pau d’arco, 50 mg garlic, 50 mg pumpkin seed
go_paradex.src: Amounts: products DB P433 (catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the Apex Energetics chart): black walnut hulls 250 mg, wormwood 100 mg, pau d'arco 100 mg, garlic extract 50 mg, pumpkin seed 50 mg per capsule; directions 'Take one capsule daily or more'. The sheet prints plain 'wormwood', the catalog's word. The species is NOT confirmed: a nutridyn.com search snippet (page never opened) reads 'Sweet Wormwood (herbs and leaves)', and retail panels disagree ('Sweet wormwood 100 mg' on one, 'Wormwood (herbs and leaves) 100 mg' on another). Confirm on the bottle or the ND143 catalog page; if it is Artemisia absinthium (thujone), the Pharmacist check needs a seizure-medicine caution. Retail listings of the same Progressive Labs bottle add 'Not to be used by pregnant or lactating women' and 'may contain traces of tree nuts (walnut)'. Sheet dose (1 capsule twice daily) sits inside 'one capsule daily or more'; Asher's GI-MAP protocol uses 1 capsule 3 times daily. Bottle is the Progressive Professional brand sold through NutriDyn (P433 90C, ND144 10/1/26). Bleeding caution on the back: garlic, Heck 2000 (PMID 10902065); pau d'arco's lapachol blocks vitamin K recycling the way warfarin does, Preusch PC et al. Arch Biochem Biophys 1989;269:18-24, PMID 2916837.

go_sboulardii.name: S. boulardii
go_sboulardii.key: 5 billion CFU Saccharomyces boulardii (Lynside) per capsule
go_sboulardii.src: NutriDyn sell sheet ND170 Rev. 8/25 (UltraBiotic Saccharomyces boulardii), opened 2026-11-03; also labels.json. The bottle's name is UltraBiotic Saccharomyces boulardii: the sheet prints 'S. boulardii' under the photo and 'UltraBiotic' on the size line, so the name fits one line and the five columns stay level. Saccharomyces boulardii (Lynside) 5 billion CFU per capsule; 'Take one capsule twice daily'; caution: pregnant, nursing or taking medication, consult; vegetarian (hypromellose). Products DB R226 agrees on 8 charts. The sheet shows the label dose. Timing: between meals, 2 hours from the herbs taken with meals (Asher's rule from his case notes: probiotics 2 hours away from antimicrobials; GI-MAP protocol: Nutricidin away from probiotics) and apart from Binder Pro at bedtime. The rhythm panel has no between-meals slot yet, so the two capsules sit in the Morning and Evening-meal boxes with their real time written on them (2 hours after breakfast; mid-afternoon, not with dinner).

go_binder_pro.name: Binder Pro
go_binder_pro.key: Per 2 capsules: 500 mg apple pectin, 300 mg humic-fulvic complex, 300 mg chlorella
go_binder_pro.src: NutriDyn sell sheet ND1141 Rev. 12/25 (Binder Pro), opened 2026-11-03; also labels.json: per 2 capsules apple pectin 500 mg, humic fulvic carbon complex (25% humic acid, 6% fulvic acid, Humiplex) 300 mg, chlorella (Chlorella vulgaris) 300 mg; 'Take two capsules daily'; caution: pregnant, nursing or taking medication, consult; vegetarian. Products DB R178 agrees. Some NutriDyn storefront pages still show an older zeolite, activated charcoal and chlorella formula; the 12/25 sell sheet and the 10/1/26 catalog read give this one. Timing: alone at bedtime, 2 hours after the evening meal and 2 hours away from the probiotic, medicines and other pills (a binder taken with other pills can carry them out). Binder role in the 5R: the NutriDyn GLC 2023 5R protocol and NutriDyn's 5R product grid. Chlorella's vitamin K can weaken warfarin (MedlinePlus chlorella monograph, not re-opened this session).
